title: How to Integrate Pricing Systems With the Financial ERP
summary: See how dynamic pricing data connects to financial ERP systems, without duplicating the pricing engine's job.
body_markdown:
Integrating pricing systems with the financial ERP means the rates your pricing tool determines flow into financial tracking and owner payout calculations automatically — without Jestor trying to replace the pricing engine itself. In **Jestor** , this is a data-connection role, feeding structured financial and operational workflows.


Short-stay operators often use a dedicated dynamic pricing tool, which makes sense — pricing optimization is a specialized function. The integration question is how that pricing data flows into everything else.


## What disconnected pricing and financial data costs


- Manual re-entry of pricing data into financial tracking or owner reports
- No connection between a booking's actual rate and the revenue-share calculation
- Delayed visibility into how pricing changes affect projected revenue
- Reconciliation errors between what the pricing tool set and what's recorded financially


## How pricing-to-ERP integration works


- Booking rate data, however it's determined, connects into the operational and financial record
- Revenue-share and owner payout calculations use the actual booked rate automatically
- Native **Omie** or **Conta Azul** integration keeps financial records aligned
- Dashboards can show pricing performance alongside occupancy and revenue data


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Jestor doesn't try to replace a dedicated pricing engine — it structures what happens with the data
- Revenue-share and financial calculations use accurate, connected rate data
- Native ERP integration removes manual re-entry between pricing and financial tracking
- Dashboards combine pricing, occupancy, and revenue into one view


Function Where it happens


Dynamic pricing optimization Dedicated pricing tool


Financial and payout calculation using that data Jestor, connected to the ERP


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does Jestor set or optimize pricing itself?** No, it structures how pricing data connects to financial and operational workflows. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can revenue-share calculations use the actual booked rate?** Yes, once that rate data is connected into the structure.


**Does this require manual re-entry between the pricing tool and the ERP?** No, once connected, the data flows without manual re-entry.
